newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-JAYASURIYA SEIZES INITIATIVE FOR SRI LANKA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-JAYASURIYA SEIZES INITIATIVE FOR SRI LANKA.

text.p: Openers Sanath Jayasuriya and Russell Arnold shared a record opening partnership for Sri Lanka against Pakistan to steer their side to 94-0 at lunch on the first day of the second test match in Colombo on Saturday.
Jayasuriya, scoring freely, was unbeaten on 71 at the interval, justifying captain Arjuna Ranatunga's decision to bat first after winning the toss in the morning.

Arnold, playing just his second test, contributed a modest unbeaten 22 while Jayasuriya hit a depleted Pakistan bowling attack all over the Sinhalese Sports Club (SSC) ground. He completed his seventh test fifty off just 47 balls in 74 minutes and his 50 included nine fours.

The Sri Lankan opener also completed 1,000 runs in test cricket in his 23rd match, becoming the 11th batsman to reach the milestone for his country. His opening stand with Arnold has already surpassed the previous best of 81 between Roshan Mahanama and Chandika Hathurusingha at Faisalabad in 1991-92.
Sri Lanka made three changes from the first test while Pakistan retained the same team.
